proof_scope: Production listener supervisor with controlled local HTTP and instrumented substitute recorder subprocesses. No audio hardware or Meet capture.

claims.proves: Supervisor lifecycle stops capture workers on pause, New, consent loss, backend failure and teardown, and resumes the same consented session.
claims.does_not_prove: Real recorder shutdown, PipeWire blocking-read cleanup, Bluetooth routing, microphone capture, STT quality or Google Meet acceptance.
